title: Squeeze the most power out of a source
story: A 12 V battery drives 3 kOhm over 6 kOhm, and the load slot sits across the 6 kOhm. Get at least 7.5 mW into the load. Only one of the four resistors can do it.

goals.label: at least 7.5 mW in the load

hints: Find the Thevenin equivalent: Vth = 12 x 6 / 9 = 8 V, Rth = 3 kOhm || 6 kOhm = 2 kOhm.
The most any load can get is Vth^2 / (4 Rth) = 8 mW, and only when RL = Rth. Half or double Rth gives just 7.1 mW.
